name: crush-style
description: Crush CLI look for Claude Code: Charm palette, bordered tool rows, gradient spinner, session sidebar

sidebar.title: Open the sidebar on start
sidebar.description: Open the Crush-style session sidebar by itself in the fullscreen layout. /sidebar toggles it either way.

band.title: Status band above the prompt
band.description: Show a one-line model, context and cost band above the prompt while no sidebar is docked.

toolGroups.title: Read and search runs
toolGroups.description: expand draws every read, search and listing as its own row, as Crush does; fold keeps Claude Code's one-line count.

spinnerWords.title: Spinner wording
spinnerWords.description: crush says Thinking, Generating and so on; claude keeps Claude Code's own verbs.
